mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4.7% (0.2pp increase in 3 months) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO above 110) signals a healthy supply chain and expanding economy, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 110, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month rise in CPIAUCSL above 0.3% signals rising inflation, prompting potential monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening housing market, which typically precedes broader economic expansion and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST rises, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a monetary tightening cycle, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
